status: Recorder-only fix with focused CPU Qt regression; fresh whole capture still required

actual_failure.reason: The actual legend still exceeds the figure canvas
actual_failure.precision: First figure fit failed. Only figure_data_00 exists. 17_readable_figure_00 is begun inside fit_legend before containment validation; guarded cleanup seals it on error. Its raw presence does not establish first-figure success or a second-figure failure.

source_cause: FigureSettingsDialog initializes legend position to best regardless of existing outside-anchored legend. Host select_combo skips an unchanged index, so apply_legend is never invoked. The real handler rebuilds axis.legend without the old bbox_to_anchor when the actual choice changes.
minimal_remedy: When the combo already reads best, choose upper right and then best through the existing physical selection helper. Existing axes/data and strict containment check remain unchanged. No app or gate change.
